description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with good math literacy and better computer skills. It is a wide covering field. Graduates have strong capabilities in computer software applications and development and initial network design with the grasp of the basic tenets of modern communication and strong mathematical modeling capabilities so that they can apply scientific calculation methods and tools to solve practical problems. Graduates are qualified for such jobs as information processing and decision-making, computer-aided design, scientific and engineering computing, systems management and office automation and computer applications management in the field of education, scientific research, communications, and other enterprises. By giving full play to the advantages in the disciplines of information of the university, it has become an interdisciplinary. At the same time, it focuses on solid foundation training for a strong adaptability.

duration.text: The Information and Computing Science at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
